boundaries_preserved: independent restoration verifier and durable unproven reservations
implementation: EpisodeWorkDeadlineExceeded is an EpisodeOwnershipError subclass only for a finite valid monotonic clock at/past the work boundary. Guard catches that typed expiry in the active work loop and prelaunch outer boundary. Nonfinite/reversed clocks and genuine identity/source failures retain generic classifications; no late current-time relabeling.
no_old_output_overwrites: Failed PR log and historical source/report receipts remain preserved; no CI retry occurred.

timeout_test_amendment.launched_requirements: Exact owned_cpu_worker_tree_quiescence_proven status, nonempty members and every retained pidfd_exit_observed, plus independent restoration before release.
timeout_test_amendment.prelaunch_requirements: Exact worker_not_started proof, no member inventory or worker identity, and neither worker stdout nor stderr launch artifact. Independent restoration/release requirements remain asserted.
timeout_test_amendment.publication_limit: A pass of this single named timeout case may follow the prelaunch path in a particular job and alone does not establish that a worker was launched/cleaned in that job. Other unchanged live timeout/borrowed/escaped-descendant cases and the deterministic launched-owner boundaries retain their separate scope.
timeout_test_amendment.reason: Work budget starts in controller before guard import/launch. A valid expiry can precede worker creation; classify it as a failed episode without inventing a killed tree.
